outcome: need for further treatment for HMB
cohort: 333 women receiving endometrial ablation for heavy menstrual bleeding in three university teaching hospitals in Spain.
finding: Bipolar-energy ablation proved very effective and safe for treating heavy menstrual bleeding, resulting in high participant satisfaction.
mod_finding: Previous transverse cesarean sections (CS) slightly reduced the effectiveness of bipolar-energy ablation, though most women with prior CSs still avoided major surgery.
